consequences: Rejected: flagging such tasks in doctor only (they would still never become ready), and dropping dangling ids on delete (loses history). Dependents of cancelled work become ready and show on the board to re-plan.
context: Before, a cancelled or deleted dependency blocked its dependents forever, since readiness required done. Deleted was settled in Phase 7a; cancelled was left as an owner decision.
decision: A task is ready when every dependsOn task is done, cancelled or deleted. A missing dependency id still blocks.
title: A cancelled dependency no longer blocks its dependents
